races.name: Mercedes-Benz Of Chichester Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Snowski
runners_data.note: Lightly raced hold-up type making hurdles debut for in-form jockey Marc Goldstein, 30 days since last run creates freshness questions

runners_data.name: Style De Folie
runners_data.note: Only confirmed pace-setter returning from 103-day break, disappointed last time but pedigree suggests hurdles will suit
runners_data.comment: With a good stable but managed only fifth of six in a bumper here on debut
runners_data.spotlight: With a good stable and has a good pedigree but managed only fifth of six on bumper debut here (good to soft) on Boxing Day.

runners_data.name: Jetaway Holiday
runners_data.note: Lightly raced Henderson runner with Nico de Boinville booking suggesting ability, unknown style creates tactical uncertainty

runners_data.name: Cockney Cleopatra
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up mare carrying 7lbs less than rivals, 153 days off creates fitness doubts despite proven soft ground form

runners_data.name: Cluain Chormaic
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer with strong recent form including a second, ideal tactical position behind the leader

runners_data.name: Hardly Surprising
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with two previous places over hurdles, 75-day gap freshens him up for this longer trip

runners_data.name: Dropematthestation
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in excellent form with recent places, Ben Pauling's 5/30 strike rate shows stable in good nick

runners_data.name: Mega Etoile
runners_data.note: Prominent type stepping up from bumpers for Henrietta Knight, 4-year-old gets valuable weight allowance
runners_data.comment: First bumper run was okay but the second was a backward step; hurdle debut today
runners_data.spotlight: Made fairly encouraging bumper debut on heavy ground in February but last month's run on good ground was a backward step; can only be watched on hurdling debut.

runners_data.name: Knight Templar
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with tendency to fade, previous efforts show he races too freely which compromises finishing kick
runners_data.comment: Showed promise in Irish points last season but safely held in two maiden hurdles this year
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise in Irish points last season but was safely held in two soft-ground maiden hurdles this year (2m/2m1f; raced too freely), and was withdrawn from a race in between with good ground deemed unsuitable.

runners_data.name: Maximum Benefit
runners_data.note: Prominent racer from small stable with Jo Davis having only one runner recently, claimer takes off 3lbs

runners_data.name: Graeme The Grey
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent type with recent course form, Tabitha Worsley's 3lb claim helps from this mark

runners_data.name: Testing Patience
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from in-form Moore yard, recent heavy ground form suggests he handles testing conditions

runners_data.name: Porridge
runners_data.note: Weak hold-up type with abysmal recent form, 7lb claimer's allowance insufficient to bridge the class gap

races.paceDynamic: Style De Folie will look to dictate from the front with no obvious speed merchants to challenge early, setting a sustainable gallop over this stamina test. The prominent brigade including Cluain Chormaic, Dropematthestation, and Mega Etoile will track just behind, while the strong contingent of hold-up horses like Cockney Cleopatra, Hardly Surprising, and Testing Patience will be held back for late challenges. With only one confirmed leader and a field loaded with horses wanting to come from behind, this sets up perfectly for front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace and have first run on the closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Style De Folie gets an uncontested lead and maintains kick
scenarios.body: Style De Folie dictates throughout and holds off late challenges, benefiting from the lack of early pace pressure. The prominent trackers also benefit from good positioning to strike late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes moderate allowing prominent horses to position perfectly
scenarios.body: Cluain Chormaic or Dropematthestation track the leader beautifully before timing their challenge to perfection in the straight. Their superior tactical positioning gives them the edge over the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle sections creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up merchants get their ideal scenario with a slowly-run race turning into a dash from the final hurdle. Cockney Cleopatra and Hardly Surprising can unleash devastating late kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Style De Folie goes off too fast or makes jumping errors early
scenarios.body: Complete tactical chaos ensues with no clear pace-setter, turning into a muddling affair that suits versatile types. The race becomes a lottery favouring those who adapt quickest to the changing dynamics.

watchPoints.text: Style De Folie must handle the 103-day layoff and early pace responsibilities without tactical support
Cockney Cleopatra faces significant fitness test after 153 days off despite her previous course form
Knight Templar's tendency to race too freely could see him fade badly again in the closing stages
Henderson's Jetaway Holiday with Nico de Boinville suggests hidden ability worth noting for market moves
Cluain Chormaic's recent consistent form makes him the logical danger to the pace-setter from an ideal tracking position

races.name: Last Resort Club Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Northanger Abbey
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with tongue-tie fitted for first time last start, represents strongest tactical threat to front-runner Tigga Time
runners_data.comment: Made quite promising handicap debut over 2m last month; moves back up in trip here
runners_data.spotlight: 0-4 over hurdles but made quite promising handicap debut when sixth of 13 at Warwick (2m, good to soft; first-time tongue-tie) last month and this move back up in trip may enable improvement; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Galactic Charm
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 30 days off, solid on similar going but needs strong pace to showcase finishing kick

runners_data.name: Duffry Trixs
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up type with excellent soft ground record, quick 19-day turnaround following recent sixth

runners_data.name: Mammies Boy
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse with mixed soft ground form, dangerous if getting into contention given class edge

runners_data.name: The Secret Pearl
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning after 103-day break with tongue-tie retained, needs strong gallop to be effective

runners_data.name: Bridge
runners_data.note: Recent course winner raised 6lbs but suited by quick 12-day turnaround, proven hold-up tactics on this track
runners_data.comment: Returned to form and won by 7l here 12 days ago; raised 6lb
runners_data.spotlight: Bounced back from a poor run and rewarded strong market support when scoring by 7l here (2m1f, good to soft) 12 days ago; 6lb rise puts him on new career-high mark but he won't mind if the ground is quicker today; respected.

runners_data.name: Herbygoesbananas
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning after 65-day absence, limited hurdling experience but showed promise at this course
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner; only minor promise over hurdles so far; may improve in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Ready bumper winner in 2024; showed only minor promise in first three hurdle races, with best effort probably his sixth over C&D (soft) on second occasion, but is open to improvement on this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Tigga Time
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner returning after 40-day break, key tactical advantage in field lacking pace pressure
runners_data.comment: Disappointed on only appearance this year but this mark is workable if he's back on song
runners_data.spotlight: Came good over hurdles at seventh attempt, at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) in November; disappointed on only appearance this year (in February) but current mark ought to be workable if he's back on song.

runners_data.name: Lyle View
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer on massive 429-day layoff, unknown quantity but won well last completed start
runners_data.comment: Won in good style when last in action but that was in February 2025; market instructive
runners_data.spotlight: Displayed significant improvement to win in good style at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft; well backed) in February 2025, her sixth start over hurdles; could quite plausibly have more to offer but this is her first run since; market instructive.

races.paceDynamic: Tigga Time stands out as the only confirmed front-runner in this nine-runner field, likely to dictate terms from the front without serious early pressure. With seven of the nine runners adopting hold-up tactics (Galactic Charm, Duffry Trixs, Mammies Boy, The Secret Pearl, Bridge, Herbygoesbananas, Lyle View), only Northanger Abbey showing prominent tendencies to potentially apply any pressure. The pace will build gradually over this 2m3f trip on soft ground, with the large hold-up contingent creating a compressed field turning for home. This race shape strongly favours prominent/handy horses who can position close enough to strike when the pace lifts, as pure hold-up horses may struggle to make up ground from too far back in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tigga Time Controls Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Tigga Time gets an uncontested lead with Northanger Abbey tracking at comfortable distance
scenarios.body: The gallop builds steadily but never becomes truly searching, allowing handy horses to strike late while back-runners find insufficient pace to showcase their finishing kicks. Prominent runners and those able to get into good early positions benefit from the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Compressed Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate throughout with the field bunched turning in
scenarios.body: Seven hold-up horses converge simultaneously in the final half-mile creating a cavalry charge finish where the best handicapped and most progressive horses prevail. Raw ability trumps tactics when the race becomes a pure sprint from the last hurdle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Northanger Abbey or others challenge Tigga Time early creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The stronger gallop spreads the field and plays to the strengths of genuine staying types and those with proven stamina reserves over this trip. Hold-up horses with finishing kicks benefit from the end-to-end nature.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tigga Time Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Tigga Time establishes unassailable advantage and maintains kick for home
scenarios.body: The front-runner's class and tactical position prove decisive when no serious challenge materializes, particularly if the ground continues to favour those who can travel strongly throughout. Gets first run on the field when it matters.

watchPoints.text: Tigga Time's jumping under pressure if challenged early, as front-runners can compound errors when headed
Bridge's ability to reproduce recent course form under 6lb penalty, as handicapper may have caught up with improvement
The Secret Pearl and Lyle View handling their respective long layoffs, as both return after significant absences
Northanger Abbey's early positioning, as prominent tactics could disrupt Tigga Time's rhythm and change race dynamics
How quickly the hold-up brigade can get into contention from the back, as moderate pace may not suit their running styles

races.name: Southern Cranes And Access Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Maclaine
runners_data.note: Returns from 533-day break but drops to winning mark, needs prominent position to use fresh legs effectively
runners_data.comment: Absent since below-par run in October 2024 and entitled to benefit from this outing
runners_data.spotlight: Now only 1lb higher than for emphatic win at Newbury (2m6f, good to soft) in March 2024 but absent since a lesser effort the following October and entitled to benefit from this outing.

runners_data.name: Duhallow Tommy
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with four chase wins, trainer in perfect form (2/2) and recent respectable third suggests readiness
runners_data.comment: Four chase wins, the latest off reduced mark in February; a possible if able to dominate
runners_data.spotlight: Four chase wins, the latest from the front off reduced mark at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft) in February; just a respectable third of five at Wincanton (2m4f, good to soft) last month but could be hard to catch if able to dominate here.

runners_data.name: Mumford's Magic
runners_data.note: Non-runner withdrawn, would have been hold-up specialist needing pace collapse
runners_data.comment: Well beaten over marathon trip last time but previously in good form over 2m4f/3m
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten over marathon trip last time but looked as good as ever when winning at Doncaster (3m, soft) two starts ago, and has previously run well over 2m4f; may not be favoured by the drying ground here but can feature if first-time cheekpieces have any positive effect.

runners_data.name: Rip Wheeler
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who needs well-timed Dunne ride, quirky when hitting front but effective over similar distances
runners_data.comment: Quirky customer who has won three times under well-timed Robert Dunne rides this season
runners_data.spotlight: Quirky customer who doesn't find much when striking the front but has won three times under well-timed Robert Dunne rides this season; unraced beyond about 2m4f under rules but well suited by good/good to soft ground and probably still on a workable mark.

runners_data.name: Hawaii Du Mestivel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping back up from hurdles, two pulls-ups in chases this year raise reliability concerns
runners_data.comment: Progressive over hurdles in 2024; missed 2025; pulled up in two chases this year
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive over hurdles in 2024, winning three times, but missed 2025 and has been pulled up in two chases this year; combination of return to better ground and first-time cheekieces might aid a revival but others in this field have much less to prove.

races.paceDynamic: Duhallow Tommy will lead from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters, creating a controlled tempo that suits his patient tactical approach. Hawaii Du Mestivel and Maclaine may press from prominent positions early, but neither has the profile to truly pressure the leader through the mid-race sections. The lack of early pace pressure means Duhallow Tommy can dictate terms and kick for home when ready, while the hold-up horses Rip Wheeler and potentially Mumford's Magic will need the pace to collapse late to be effective. This pace shape strongly favours prominent runners and the proven front-runner who can control the tempo without being harassed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Duhallow Tommy gets an easy lead and isn't pressed until the straight
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate perfect fractions and has enough left to repel late challenges, while prominent runners get first run on any hold-up horses. This setup perfectly suits Duhallow Tommy's four chase wins from the front and gives Maclaine the tactical position he needs fresh from a long break.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and hold-up horses get perfect positioning
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows closers to travel smoothly into contention and deliver decisive late runs when fresher horses tire. Rip Wheeler's tactical speed under Dunne's well-timed rides becomes decisive, while any returning Mumford's Magic could benefit from the patient approach.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Hawaii Du Mestivel and Maclaine press Duhallow Tommy from early stages
scenarios.body: The increased pace pressure tests the leader's stamina over this extended trip while setting up the race for a sustained battle between the front three. Maclaine's superior rating and fresh legs could prove decisive if the pace becomes genuinely testing.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Duhallow Tommy goes extremely slowly and gets caught napping
scenarios.body: The pedestrian fractions allow all runners to stay in touch deep into the race, creating a sprint finish that favours pure class and tactical positioning. The highest-rated runner with tactical speed could emerge from the pack finish.

watchPoints.text: Hawaii Du Mestivel has been pulled up twice in chases this year - any signs of reluctance or jumping errors could see another withdrawal from the contest
Duhallow Tommy's jumping and fluency early - if he makes any significant errors he could get pressured by the prominent runners when he needs an easy lead
Rip Wheeler's positioning through halfway - Dunne needs him handy enough to strike but not so close he hits the front too soon given his finishing quirks
Maclaine's fitness levels given the 533-day absence - any signs of ring-rustiness in the early stages could compromise his chances despite the favorable rating
The pace through the first mile - if genuinely pedestrian it opens the door for hold-up horses, if genuinely strong it sets up Maclaine's return

races.name: Land & Power Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Godot
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 12 days since last run, suited by soft going but may find himself too far back if Confinentic controls the pace

runners_data.name: Ferret Jeeter
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with three hurdle wins this season, Chad Bament's 7-pound claim valuable over this trip
runners_data.comment: Three hurdles wins this season; back in this sphere after winning chase debut last month
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner this season and added to his tally on last month's chasing debut at Plumpton (3m1f, good to soft), asserting on run-in to score by 5l; only 3lb higher for this return to hurdling and won't mind if the ground ends up good; sports first-time blinkers; must be considered.

runners_data.name: Confinentic
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who can dictate terms in small field, but form this season has been disappointing and carries top weight
runners_data.comment: Yet to hit top gear this season but his Ascot run two starts ago makes him of interest
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to hit top gear after four runs this season and was behind Ferret Jeeter when remote third at Plumpton (3m1f, good to soft) last month but his fifth of 18 at Ascot (2m7f, good to soft) two starts ago came in a much stronger race than this; can't be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Staff Sergeant Len
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with career-best Newbury third last time, trainer Neil Mulholland in good form but needs pace to develop
runners_data.comment: Arguably showed career-best form when placed on recent stable debut a Newbury
runners_data.spotlight: Signed off for Syd Hosie with disappointing chase run in January but arguably posted career-best performance when close third of 14 over hurdles at Newbury (3m, good to soft) for new stable last month; quicker ground will also suit; respected.

runners_data.name: Vendant
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from layoff with encouraging second here 12 days ago, significantly lighter weight could aid stamina
runners_data.comment: 0-8 over hurdles but came second here (2m5f) recently, after a layoff
runners_data.spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles but returned from 11-month break with fairly good second here (2m5f, good to soft; no match for winner) 12 days ago and could plausibly still have untapped potential over this longer trip.

races.paceDynamic: Confinentic will set the pace from the front with minimal pressure in this small field, as the other prominent runners Ferret Jeeter and Vendant are unlikely to apply serious early pressure. The hold-up horses Godot and Staff Sergeant Len will track from mid-division through the early stages. With Confinentic able to dictate fractions unopposed, this sets up as a tactical affair where the leader can control the tempo and kick clear, or alternatively create a genuine test that sets up the closers. This pace dynamic favours prominent runners who can position close to Confinentic and respond to his moves, rather than hold-up horses who may find themselves too far back when the real race begins.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Confinentic Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Confinentic gets an uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The front-runner can reserve energy for a decisive move approaching the final hurdle, making it difficult for hold-up horses to close the gap. Prominent runners positioned within striking distance benefit most from being able to respond immediately to Confinentic's acceleration.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Ferret Jeeter or Vendant press Confinentic early and force genuine fractions
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out stamina reserves and set up a strong finish for hold-up horses who can pick up the pieces. Staff Sergeant Len and Godot benefit from their patient tactics as the early leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If all prominent runners are content to sit and wait behind Confinentic through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where positioning and jockey timing matter most, potentially suiting the most progressive horse. Ferret Jeeter's recent chase win suggests he has improvement in him, while Vendant showed promise on comeback.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Confinentic Weakens Late
scenarios.trigger: If the leader's lack of recent form catches up and he fades approaching the final hurdle
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses can capitalize on the collapse of the pace angle, with Staff Sergeant Len's Newbury third suggesting he has the class to take advantage. The race opens up for closers who have been patiently positioned.

watchPoints.text: Confinentic may get too easy a lead early if no prominent runner pressures him, allowing him to dictate ideal fractions
Ferret Jeeter's jumping under pressure after stepping up from hurdles to chases, any mistake could derail his chance
Staff Sergeant Len needs the early pace to be genuine to bring his finishing kick into play over this extended trip
Godot's hold-up style may be compromised if the pace becomes tactical and he's caught too far back turning for home
Vendant's stamina for this longer trip remains unproven despite recent encouraging form over shorter distances

races.name: Southern Contract Lifting Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Valirann Gold

runners_data.comment: Produced remarkable late surge to win here recently but is too inconsistent to rely upon
runners_data.spotlight: Produced remarkable late surge to snatch what had looked an unlikely victory here (2m5f, good to soft; blinkers removed) 12 days ago; recent 3lb rise is manageable but this inconsistent 9yo tends to race lazily nowadays and it's hard to predict his mood today.

runners_data.name: Gorcombe Moonshine
runners_data.note: Prominent style runner, good second at Hereford last month but trainer's poor 14-day record (0/3) is concerning
runners_data.comment: Has modest strike-rate but gave good account last month, after a break
runners_data.spotlight: Just 1-33 under rules but the win came here (in 2023) and he gave a good account when second from out of the weights at Hereford (2m5f, good) last month, after a break; could have a say.

runners_data.name: Kill The Groove
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making chasing debut with cheekpieces, 0-7 over hurdles but consistent frame finisher this year
runners_data.comment: Made the frame on all three hurdling starts this year and has possibilities on chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles but made the frame on all three outings this year (all over 2m at Plumpton); moves back up in trip for this chasing debut with cheekpieces (worn once) removed; seems versatile regarding ground; can feature if he gets into a good jumping rhythm.

runners_data.name: Hobie
runners_data.note: Prominent runner for in-form trainer (2/7 in 14 days), carried 3lb claim and won last time but going up in trip

runners_data.name: Wellwillya
runners_data.note: Only confirmed hold-up horse gives tactical advantage, dual chase winner this season suited by track and distance
runners_data.comment: Dual chase winner this season; ran big race in defeat last month and this track suits well
runners_data.spotlight: Dual chase winner this season (2m1f/2m5f); ran big race in defeat at Exeter (2m3f, good to soft) last month and is also well suited by this track; ought to make his presence felt again.

runners_data.name: Misteroddsocks
runners_data.note: Prominent runner, 11-race maiden with recent wind operation after unconvincing fence record needs improvement
runners_data.comment: Has unconvincing record over fences this season; needs recent wind op to make a difference
runners_data.spotlight: 11-race maiden with unconvincing record over fences this season (five attempts; remote when third last time); needs recent wind op to have made a difference.

runners_data.name: Millies Mite
runners_data.note: Prominent runner, won 2024 edition of this race but absent 107 days since consecutive pulled-ups raises fitness doubts
runners_data.comment: Ended 2025 in poor form but both her wins were gained over C&D; revival possible
runners_data.spotlight: Gained both wins over C&D on good ground, including 2024 edition of this race; absent since pulled up on consecutive outings towards end of last year but it won't be a shock if she bounces back to form; 1lb wrong.

runners_data.name: Rap Soul
runners_data.note: Sole front runner, 2-2 in handicap chases this year but both wins came in small fields at different track
runners_data.comment: 2-2 since switched to chasing this year and could easily have more improvement to come
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in three maiden hurdles in the autumn but 2-2 since switched to handicap chases this year, with both wins gained in small fields at Plumpton (2m4f, soft/good); has a bit more on his plate today but may still have more improvement to come.

runners_data.name: Engaging Sam
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making chasing debut with first-time visor, 0-12 over hurdles and well beaten this season
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in all three hurdle races this season and 4lb wrong for this chasing debut
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in all three hurdle races this season and now 0-12 in that sphere; swaps usual cheekpieces for first-time visor on this chasing debut; 4lb out of the weights; difficult to enthuse over.

races.paceDynamic: Rap Soul will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable pace without pressure early. Behind him, four prominent runners (Valirann Gold, Gorcombe Moonshine, Kill The Groove, Hobie) will create significant traffic congestion in the prominent positions, with Misteroddsocks, Millies Mite and Engaging Sam adding to the squeeze. This bunching will cause positioning problems turning for home, with interference likely 2-3 out as they fan out for racing room. The sole hold-up horse Wellwillya benefits from this pace dynamic, getting a true gallop to aim at while avoiding the early traffic.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates the expected traffic problems and interference 2-3 out...
scenarios.body: Wellwillya gets the perfect setup with a solid pace to aim at and clean passage on the outside while the others get tangled up. The dual chase winner has the class and tactical advantage to pick off tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Rap Soul gets an easy lead and the prominent pack fail to apply enough pressure...
scenarios.body: The front runner can dictate fractions and kick clear when the bunched field behind gets into trouble, using his two recent chase wins as confidence. His 30-day break keeps him fresh for a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets the perfect early position and avoids the traffic...
scenarios.body: Valirann Gold or Gorcombe Moonshine could capitalize on their recent good form if they secure the ideal slot just off the pace. Their experience at the track becomes crucial in finding racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Lottery
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong and multiple horses fade badly in the soft ground...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl that suits any horse with a finishing kick, regardless of usual style. Form lines become less reliable as stamina and ground conditions take over.

watchPoints.text: Watch for severe traffic problems in the prominent positions 2-3 furlongs out as Valirann Gold, Gorcombe Moonshine, Kill The Groove and Hobie all seek similar racing room
Monitor if Rap Soul gets too easy a lead early as the prominent pack may give him too much rope to dictate fractions
Observe Wellwillya's positioning turning in as the sole hold-up horse should have clearest passage while others bunch
Check Kill The Groove's jumping on chasing debut as any mistakes could cause interference in the already crowded prominent positions
Watch for any early signs of the 107-day layoff affecting Millies Mite's fitness despite her course and distance win last year

races.name: KSR Lighting, The Ultimate Lighting Solutions Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Frank Stamper
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid form who stayed on well for second at Plumpton and could benefit from patient tactics on this softer ground
runners_data.comment: Beaten favourite last time but has claims if judged on earlier Plumpton second
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten favourite when only seventh at Wincanton (1m7f, good to soft) last month and now 0-5 over hurdles but stayed on from poor position for second at Plumpton (2m, soft) two starts ago and may still have potential.

runners_data.name: Ikigai Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up type better on good ground but has won three times over hurdles and showed signs of ability when third at Huntingdon after a break
runners_data.comment: Didn't run badly last month, after a break, and has become well handicapped
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner on good ground; arguably ran better than eventual 48l defeat suggests when third at Huntingdon (2m3f, good) last month, after a layoff, and has become well handicapped; could have a say if that recent outing brought him on.

runners_data.name: Calshot Spit
runners_data.note: Prominent racer and dual course winner who can control the pace from the front and has winning form on heavy ground
runners_data.comment: Dual C&D winner, latterly on Boxing Day; versatile ground-wise but has become inconsistent
runners_data.spotlight: Dual C&D winner, more recently when clinging on by a nose on Boxing Day (heavy ground); back on the same mark today and will also be suited by these much quicker conditions but has not fired on either outing this year.

runners_data.name: Ballylicky Bay
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse open to improvement after better fifth at Warwick last month and gets significant weight allowance for handicap debut
runners_data.comment: Improved form when 200-1 fifth at Warwick last month; now makes handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Point/bumper winner; soundly beaten on first two hurdling starts but her 200-1 fifth at Warwick (2m, good to soft) last month was much better and she's open to further improvement in handicaps.

runners_data.name: Tyson
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won readily as odds-on favorite at Newcastle last week and drops back in trip with strong stable form behind him
runners_data.comment: Won readily when odds-on at Newcastle last week; probably still well treated under penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish 6yo; initially disappointing for new stable this year but was made odds-on favourite at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) last week and won readily; drops back in trip here; probably still well treated under 7lb penalty.

runners_data.name: Jacquetta
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with headgear and concerning finishing record but gets lowest weight and could benefit from handicap debut off lowly mark
runners_data.comment: Has lowly mark for this handicap debut and good market support will make him of interest
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten on all three hurdling starts (2m1f-2m3f) but has a lowly mark for this handicap debut and good market support will bring him into the equation; sports first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Tommy Dillion
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse with front-running tendencies who ran well third over course and distance 12 days ago but very exposed at 10 years old
runners_data.comment: Ran well over C&D recently but the drying ground is not in his favour today
runners_data.spotlight: Put in pretty good front-running shift when third over C&D (good to soft) 12 days ago but he's a lot more exposed than some of these, and his two hurdling wins were gained on heavy ground.

runners_data.name: Master Dunraven
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who flopped as odds-on favorite last time but showed promise with keeping-on third at Plumpton before that
runners_data.comment: Flopped when odds-on last time and now 0-8 over hurdles but major player on January form
runners_data.spotlight: Fair Flat racer; flopped when odds-on at Wetherby six weeks ago and is now 0-8 over hurdles but suggested his turn might be near when keeping-on third at Plumpton (2m, soft) two starts ago, and it will be interesting to see whether his supporters wade in again here.

races.paceDynamic: Calshot Spit is the sole confirmed front runner and will set the tempo from the outset without pressure from other pace angles. Tommy Dillion showed front-running tendencies last time at this course but at 10 years old may not sustain early pressure against a fresher Calshot Spit. The lack of pace pressure means Calshot Spit can dictate fractions and potentially steal a march on the field. This controlled tempo heavily favours prominent racers who can track the leader and hold-up horses with tactical speed, as the pace-setter may prove difficult to peg back if allowed easy fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Calshot Spit Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Calshot Spit gets uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The dual course winner can exploit his tactical advantage by controlling the race from the front, making it difficult for hold-up horses to close the gap. His proven course form and ability to win from the front position makes him perfectly suited to capitalize on the lack of pace pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Close Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and allows closers time to wind up
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop gives patient horses like Frank Stamper and Tyson time to get organized and mount their challenges. Both have shown good finishing kicks when given time and the tactical race setup plays to their strengths.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Calshot Spit faces unexpected early pressure or doesn't see out trip
scenarios.body: Any horse that can sit prominent behind the leader gains the perfect tracking position to strike when the pace-setter weakens. The moderate early pace followed by a quickening suits horses with tactical awareness who can position close up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to make the running early and they crawl along
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle with hold-up horses having every chance to get competitive. This unusual scenario would favor the freshest finishers with the best turn of foot.

watchPoints.text: Calshot Spit getting uncontested early lead could prove decisive as the sole pace angle with proven course form
Tyson's recent Newcastle win and drop back in trip makes him dangerous if the pace sets up for his late kick
Frank Stamper's patient hold-up style could be perfectly suited if Calshot Spit goes too fast too early
Tommy Dillion's 10-year-old legs may not sustain any early pace pressure against fresher Calshot Spit
Jacquetta getting market support despite poor finishing record suggests stable confidence in handicap debut
